visual.description: FULL-SCREEN pattern interrupt — NO race chart on screen. Two before/after split cards stacked vertically. Top card: Doritos — left side shows '12 oz' bag (full-size icon), right side shows '9.25 oz' bag (visibly smaller icon). A red '-23%' badge animates in between them (spring, 15 frames). Bottom card: Folgers — left '16 oz' can, right '10.3 oz' can, '-36%' badge. Cards use surface background rgba(255,255,255,0.06) with border. Brand names in Inter 20px Accent Cream, weights in JetBrains Mono 28px. At voiceover mention of BLS stat, a callout card fades in at bottom: 'Snack food downsizing: 2.64% cumulative (2015–2019)' in JetBrains Mono 18px on surface card. This scene deliberately breaks from the chart to give the viewer's eyes a reset before the skimpflation concept scene.

notes: PATTERN INTERRUPT: This scene deliberately exits the race chart entirely. The viewer has been staring at the chart since scene 006 (~3.5 minutes). Full-screen before/after split cards break visual monotony. Shrink animations should be dramatic — spring stiffness 100, damping 20. The -23% and -36% badges animate in with a slight bounce. BLS stat card uses surface background. Voiceover says 'reportedly' and 'according to consumer tracking' — these are hedged claims (⚠️ unverified in research). After this scene, viewer returns to chart context in scene 015.
